design_philosophy: E1 Strategy: Education platforms for underrepresented learners often feel either too corporate/sterile or too childish. We break this by using a 'Vibrant Play + Neo-Brutalist' aesthetic. This combines the approachability of bright, optimistic colors with the 'streetwear' credibility of stark, high-contrast black borders and bold geometric typography. It feels empowering, modern, and distinctively anti-SaaS.

headings.instruction: Do not use generic fonts like Inter. Use fluid typography scaling, e.g., text-4xl md:text-6xl for hero headers.

body.instruction: Ensure high legibility. Avoid light gray text on white backgrounds.

monospace.instruction: Use for code snippets, curriculum module tags, or time indicators.

spacing_and_layout.instruction: All bordered containers must have internal padding (e.g., p-6) to prevent text collision. Use asymmetry to create visual tension.

inputs.instruction: Use heavily customized Shadcn Input and Select components, enforcing the 2px black border and ring-focus.

pages.name: Smart Registration Wizard
pages.layout: Centered constrained column, full viewport height (Typeform style).
features: One question per screen for low cognitive load.
Progress bar must be a thick, vibrant block element, not a thin native UI line.
Massive playful typography for the active question.

pages.name: Student Learning Dashboard
features: Welcome Banner: 12-col span. Vibrant primary color background. Shows quick stats.

Visual Roadmap (CRITICAL): 8-col span. Must not be a standard list. Render it as a winding SVG path or horizontal 'subway map' nodes representing modules/stages. Completed = filled accent color, locked = white background with dashed border.
Next Session Widget: 4-col span. Highlights upcoming 1-on-1 calls with video link CTA.

pages.name: 1-on-1 Session Booking
pages.layout: Split pane grid (Calendar on left, time slot pills on right).
features: Shadcn Calendar heavily customized. Override default soft styles with hard 2px borders and active dates in #FFD500.
Time slots as chunky, interactive pill buttons.

pages.name: Instructor Hub & Admin Overview
pages.layout: Control Room Grid (Dense, functional, md:grid-cols-4 gap-6).
features: High-contrast data tables using Shadcn, stripped of gray/soft borders and replaced with solid black separators.
Use bright tags/badges for student progress status.

image_urls.description: Diverse student coding on laptop. Use for the public landing page hero or welcome splash screens.
Mentors and students collaborating at table. Use for the 1-on-1 mentorship overview or booking section.
Woman using MacBook Pro. Good for placeholder student avatars, success stories, or testimonials.

icons.instruction: Run `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react`. Use 'duotone' weight for a playful, textured tech feel.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, roadmap nodes) MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case, role-based. e.g., data-testid='enroll-button', data-testid='login-submit-button'.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure pure black (#0A0A0A) is used for all text over the primary yellow and secondary blue backgrounds to meet WCAG AA/AAA standards.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building for a non-profit, but the UI must feel premium, empowering, and distinctive. AVOID generic Vercel-like soft minimalist SaaS looks.
Implement the Neo-Brutalist shadow effects defined in spacing_and_layout. This is non-negotiable for the brand aesthetic.
For the visual curriculum roadmap (CRITICAL), do not use a standard vertical <ul> list. Build an SVG-based timeline or a winding flexbox layout where modules look like stops on a subway map (nodes).
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for the onboarding/registration areas for maximum creative layout freedom. Use Shadcn for the deep dashboard components, heavily styled with our hard borders.
Do not use generic SaaS placeholder images. Always use the exact Unsplash URLs provided in media.image_urls.
Logo should be purely typographic using the Cabinet Grotesk font with tight tracking, e.g. `YesWeCode`.
